exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "How about if you ~? / Why don't you ~?".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～たら どうですか matches "How about if you ~? / Why don't you ~?".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～たら どうですか.
exercises.explanation: Used after verb た-form to gently suggest or recommend an action.
